reviewed_decision.decision: Accept two promising experimental operating points A16/Emean32; exactly four controls, no pooling/pruning promotion; no further tuning after TEST opens.

A16 improves mean recovery in all three families atN16; Emean32 has the lowest unpruned observed hall error and restores numerical recovery relative toA32. Most paired uncertainty remains broad. Pooling loses numerical recovery; pruning gains are matched by random deletion with lower information retention.
specific_limits: A16 role oa-burglar-neighbor-spy-ab L28p165 is a suspect direction-matching judge win.
Recovered numbers/names coexist with incompatible arithmetic/entities.
Some hall gains are wrong-to-off-topic transitions and unsupported-versus-contradictory classification is sensitive.

reviewed_decision.decision: Emean32 merits a held-out experimental tradeoff comparison; D16 remains a secondary diagnostic, not a selected explanation method. Support A16/Emean32 prospectively, with no established global faithfulness winner.
specific_limits: Emean numerical wins often recover an intermediate amid wrong starts/operations; the intermediate endpoint differs from explanation correctness.
Role outcomes depend on inconsistent matching of descriptions and names; some D16 gains combine unrelated clauses.
Emean versusA32 class changes include wrong-to-off-topic and consistent-to-wrong changes.

selection_rationale.A16: Against cappedN1: hall -0.84pp; MT +2.27pp; chain +0.91pp; role +0.53pp. N16 is the original nested prefix.
selection_rationale.Emean32: Against cappedN1: hall -2.47pp; MT +1.82pp; chain +0.45pp; role +0.44pp. AgainstA32, numerical recovery is +1.82pp with similar output length.
selection_rationale.no_pruning_or_pooling_promotion: Pruning approximately halves output length, loses MT/numerical recovery, and matched random deletion matches or improves hall error. Pooling adds compute/length without a balanced validation gain.
selection_rationale.uncertainty: Related-group bootstrap2000 draws by family, unadjusted exploratory intervals. Small family/group counts; no significance threshold and no hidden cross-family macro. Choices are promising, not established faithful improvements.

test_cohort.scope: All exact original grouped TEST cells and original family read grids; no new sites, donor redraw or changed grouping.

candidate_budget_contract.N16: Original sample indices0..15 of the same immutableN32 pool
candidate_budget_contract.reuse_policy: Consume unchanged blind-generation records and provenance only; no import, resampling, residual generation, cross-cell text aggregation or additional candidate samples.

selection_solver.fit_inputs: Centered/whitened target retains magnitude; centered/whitened phrase rows normalized by norm+1e-9
selection_solver.compatibility_only: Released80-iteration projected-gradient fit is diagnostic only; exact SciPy NNLS is the final primary selector.

whitening.convention: Symmetrize covariance in float64; ridge=max(.1*mean(diag(cov)),1e-12); inverse sqrt of nonnegative eigenvalues plus ridge; transform=(x-mu)@W.T; source-bound in reconstruction.py

encoding_execution.key_order: First occurrence in immutable flat snapshot, sample order then parser bullet order; retain that order within partitions
encoding_execution.shared_catalog: One common TEST catalog inherits immutable first-computed DEV/VAL effective-key rows. The prepared plan must bind exact partition input order/hashes and inherited catalog indexes/tensor provenance before encoding; no batch-equivalence claim.
encoding_execution.limits: Expanded DEV batch check failed provisional raw and FVE equivalence guards (max FVE drift .003524); D32 changed2/12 and E1 changed1/12 texts. Near-threshold/near-zero decisions remain sensitive; do not retune threshold using VAL.
encoding_execution.inherited_DEV_and_VAL_rows: Keep first-computed exact effective-key DEV/VAL rows unchanged, including recorded or explicitly unavailable historical batch metadata; no B32-to-B128 equivalence claim

fixed_DEV_control_bank.policy: Use unchanged previously assigned DEV donors and fixed read-site metadata; exclude target-related group; no VAL/TEST donor redraw or gold-derived control selection

randomness.digest: SHA256 of canonical sort-key compact UTF8 JSON, ensure_ascii=False
randomness.policy: Frozen per-cell seeds; no redraw based on observed outcomes

inference_contract.invalid_AR_policy: Keep raw/capped/random texts and nullable fits unchanged; A/E complete selection excludes samples containing invalid cleaned scoring atoms. Preserve fixed intended cell denominators and explicit empty/unavailable outcomes; no TEST-driven repair or alternative selection policy.
inference_contract.pruning: Excluded from final TEST menu; historical .005 pruning settings remain unchanged in VAL/DEV evidence and are not tuned or run as final TEST arms.

judgment_contract.recipe: Same pinned upstream WorkspaceBench prompts/schema and aggregation as signedVAL. Both hallucination stages; MT regex; chain final-token original grid; role all frozen sites. Exact request caching preserves source response provenance.
judgment_contract.operational_source_pins: Bind current evaluation/budget/performance and launcher sources in the separate reviewed judging spec after pending operational changes; this scientific freeze does not require the pre-change evaluation.py hash.
judgment_contract.financial_policy: Existing shared300USD hard ceiling,200USD target, all uncertain charges retained. Separate exact-cache forecast and root-sealed run cap/CPU/profile are required before paid judging.

final_evaluation.headline_endpoints: Hall wrong/(wrong+offtopic+consistent), assertion share and secondary wrong/(wrong+consistent); stage2 false-span/true-claim/unverifiable tallies with units explicit. Other families use frozen concept/intermediate/binding recovery, paired cells and upstream original-grid itemANY aggregation.
final_evaluation.coverage: All six conditions/all four original grids; API/instrument failures remain missing, never successful abstentions. Empty outputs separate from failures.
final_evaluation.uncertainty: Paired group bootstrap by family,2000 draws,seed20261010; separate family item/cell results; no hidden macro or within-item claim for cross-family tradeoff plots.
final_evaluation.traces: Same deterministic distinct-item wins/regressions and seeded unchanged sampling as signedVAL; retain exact texts, context and raw judge evidence. No selected-example proof.
final_evaluation.cost: Report new-input capture, candidate sampling, AR and control/refit CPU work separately from shared campaign-cache reuse and final judge charges. No invented GPU dollar price or measured serving latency.
final_evaluation.no_further_selection: Final settings and comparisons are fixed before any TEST readout/AR/quality access. Do not add arms, retune controls/thresholds, choose a new operating point, or reinterpret TEST as another development set. Subsequent DEV results remain descriptive only.
final_evaluation.extra_offline_menu: The existing selector may mechanically compute its fixed broader menu, but export/judge/interpret only these six signed arms; no additional test-selected scaling/composite arm.
final_evaluation.completion: Report incomplete/time-limited measurement honestly if original-grid coverage or deadline cannot be achieved; do not fabricate coverage or label unrun arms negative.
